protocol.description:
This protocol allows clients to control brightness management of outputs that are currently part of the compositor space. The intent is to allow special clients like desktop shells to set brightness.
To modify outputs not currently part of the compositor space see wlr-output-management.
Warning! The protocol described in this file is experimental and backward incompatible changes may be made. Backward compatible changes may be added together with the corresponding interface version bump. Backward incompatible changes are done by bumping the version number in the protocol and interface names and resetting the interface version. Once the protocol is declared stable, the version number in the protocol and interface names is removed and the interface version is reset.

interface.name: wsm_brightness_control_manager_v1

description.summary: manager to create per-output brightness management

interface.description: This interface is a manager that allows creating per-output brightness management controls.

request.name: get_output_brightness

description.summary: get a brightness management for an output

request.description:
Create a output brightness management control that can be used to adjust the brightness management for a given output.
The compositor sends the initial state followed by a done event. If the output does not support hardware brightness control, the method is none and all brightness values are zero.

request.name: destroy
request.description: All objects created by the manager will still remain valid, until their appropriate destroy request has been called.

interface.name: wsm_brightness_control_v1

description.summary: adjust brightness management for an output

interface.description: This object offers requests to set the brightness management value of an output.

enum.name: method
enum.description: Describes the mechanism used by the compositor to adjust the output's brightness.

entry.name: backlight
entry.summary: brightness is adjusted through a backlight device

request.name: set_brightness
request.description: Set the output's brightness. If the output does not support the given value, a failed event is sent.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroys the output brightness management control object.

event.name: brightness
event.description: This event reports the current brightness once when the wsm_brightness_control_v1 object is initialized. It is not sent for subsequent brightness changes.

event.name: min_brightness
event.description: This event reports the minimum supported brightness once when the wsm_brightness_control_v1 object is initialized. It is not sent again.

event.name: max_brightness
event.description: This event reports the maximum supported brightness once when the wsm_brightness_control_v1 object is initialized. It is not sent again.

event.name: method
event.description: This event reports the brightness adjustment method once when the wsm_brightness_control_v1 object is initialized. It is not sent again.

event.name: done
event.description: This event is sent once after the brightness, min_brightness, max_brightness, and method events have been sent. No initialization event is sent after this event.

event.name: failed
event.description:
This event indicates that the output brightness management is no longer valid. This can happen for a number of reasons, including: - The output doesn't support brightness management - The output disappeared
Upon receiving this event, the client should destroy this object.
